messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service lives with Team Cinder; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Boreal as of 2025-09-29. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-09-29; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-02-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- As of 2026-02-24, the flags service belongs to Team Cinder; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-29, the flags service belongs to Team Boreal; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-09, the flags service belongs to Team Cinder; Team Atlas ran it until then. [valid 2025-07-09 to 2025-09-29; recorded by handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags]
- Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal decided the billing service will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, and flagged it since the feature-flags service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On the 2025-08-01 rotation day, Marcus handed the Team Boreal pager to Lena. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-01]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal observed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- The billing service depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27]
- On 2025-11-20, Team Boreal took over the event bus from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- As of 2025-06-27, Team Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27-2]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-07-28, the feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of its requests were identical. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28]
- On 2025-09-08, the Team Boreal on-call swapped and Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal has taken over the catalog service from Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-06-16; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
    earlier: Team Cinder owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
